findings.problem: The ask covered only the espresso. The drink needs ice cream as well, so a server could get a yes and promise an affogato the kitchen cannot send.
findings.change: Now asks whether the bar will pull an espresso, at what price, and whether the kitchen will send vanilla ice cream for it (29 words; askId a-zr8ze4mu unchanged).

findings.problem: "Offer it as dessert menus go down" told the server to offer an off-menu drink before lineup had confirmed it.
findings.change: Added: once lineup confirms the bar and kitchen can make it.

findings.problem: "Which addition has precedent?" had more than one defensible answer: whipped cream (affogato con panna) and sea salt both have precedent in cafés.
findings.change: Reframed as a question about liqueurs: amaretto against Campari, limoncello and crème de menthe, all with the same stem shape. The explain is rewritten from the World Table list; a stays 1.
